# netactuate_cloud_deploy_sizes (Data Source)

Reads Cloud Deploy Sizes visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_deploy_sizes" "example" {
  location = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location name or code whose deploy sizes should be read.

### Optional

- `min_cpu` (Number) Minimum CPU filter for deploy sizes.
- `min_ram` (Number) Minimum RAM filter for deploy sizes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sizes` (List of Object) Deploy sizes available at the requested location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sizes))

<a id="nestedatt--sizes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sizes`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Number)
- `cpu` (Number)
- `disk` (String)
- `plan` (String)
- `plan_id` (Number)
- `port` (String)
- `price` (String)
- `ram` (String)
- `transfer` (String)
